Back-to-back double-digit fantasy performances from Corum likely have some people excited about his rest-of-season projections. I'm still of the belief that you can't start Corum without a Kyren injury. Kyren remains the RB1.
13 targets in Week 6? Yup, Coker is back. I'd prefer him to Tet at cost.
Out for 6-10 weeks with an apparent knee injury. Absolutely brutal turn of events, and possibly the mark of the end of his career.

news.title: Davante Adams to miss 6-10 weeks with ruptured hamstring

fp.note: Hand up, I was wrong on this one. Bo Nix is such a terrible passer that Jaylen Waddle is quickly becoming irrelevant for fantasy. Sell "low" if you want; I have lost all hope for this offense.
Brutal Week 6 performance from Denzel Boston, with one catch for 15 yards. This was a defensive battle through and through. Now is not the time to sell low.

injury.comment: The rookie will be good to go on Sunday, despite dealing with a foot injury at practice throughout the week. He has been good through the first five weeks of the season and can safely be started in most league formats at this point.

news.title: Denzel Boston (foot) good to go for Sunday

fp.note: I'm sure the volume and efficiency will pick back up once Lamar returns, but I'm afraid Andrews isn't any good anymore. He's so slow, stiff, and really struggles in any sort of contested-catch situation.

I'm a LaPorta fan, but his TE4 price tag is a bit expensive for me. You can likely get an even bigger premium now that he's past his bye week. I just don't feel he brings that much value over replacement at his position.
Three straight games of three or fewer receptions for Fannin. He's no longer startable, and I'm ready to hop off this train. I don't see him bouncing back enough to truly burn me if I sell low.

news.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) inactive for Week 6

fp.note: Third pass-catching offense on the Bears. There's not enough target volume going his way to trust him as a starter. Name value may still get you a decent FLEX player in return.

news.title: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) hopeful to be fine
Stefon Diggs (hamstring) active for Week 6

injury.comment: A report by Rapoport noted Hurts played in London with no sleep, as sleep was a risk for the QB. This is obviously extremely serious news for Hurts, his family, and the team, so don’t lose sight of that, but it’s relieving to hear he should make a full recovery. As for football, it’s a big blow for an already struggling Eagles team, who will now proceed with Tanner McKee at QB. Don’t be surprised if Cole Payton also sees some run towards the end of the year if things really fly south for the Eagles.

news.title: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) out for the season as additional clots are found
Tank Dell (knee) to play in Week 7

fp.note: Tyler Shough now has 14 touchdowns through six games. He only threw for 144 yards in Week 6 but found the end zone four times. This guy just knows how to score fantasy points; no need to complicate it.
The target volume is spread out more than we'd like, but Burden is technically the top target option in a Caleb Williams-led offense. That's enough for me.

news.title: Pat Freiermuth (calf) officially active for Week 6

fp.note: DK Metcalf is your perennial underperformer relative to expected fantasy points. Finally, we had a good game in Week 6, but it felt like it could've been much better. At least the target volume has been elite this season. I'm holding and continuing to plug into my lineup.

injury.comment: Metcalf had been listed as questionable with an illness. He'll be good to go with the Steelers wide receiver room depleted.

news.title: DK Metcalf (illness) off injury report Sunday

fp.note: The volume is there, but Pollard is so dusty at this point and this run game is not competent enough to ever feel great about starting Pollard. I'd try to sell for a younger asset who maybe hasn't broken out yet, but has a chance to expand their role.

Carnell Tate is so far and away the best player on the Titans, it's not even funny. If they want to build on the momentum of the Week 6 win, they'll need to force-feed Tate the same way Rutgers force-feeds KJ Duff.
